title: Playground
description: The plain viewer with every option, theme token and built-in control in one panel. Show only a clade, collapse clades or weakly supported branches. Try it on trees from 6 tips to 2.4 million, or on a file of your own. The URL keeps your settings, so a view can be shared.

title: Custom styling: a Reactree look-alike
description: The Reactree viewer's toolbars, icons, modes and look, rebuilt on the public API: <TreeView>, tree-ops for every edit, a control of our own for node labels, and a theme made only of CSS custom properties. Its README lists what could not be matched.
